tasks.label: find-php
tasks.command: $paths = @('C:\xampp\php\php.exe','C:\php\php.exe'); foreach ($p in $paths) { if (Test-Path $p) { Write-Output "FOUND:$p" } }; $env:PATH -split ';' | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match 'php|xampp') { Write-Output $_ } }

tasks.label: find-php-tools
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem 'C:\xampp\php' -Filter '*cs*fix*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName; Get-ChildItem 'C:\xampp\php' -Filter 'php-cs-fixer*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName
